  "thinking": "Sam's split is cleaner than the belly fight: Maya takes the tail join and fin edges, I take the eye and dorsal fin, and Grace has the belly. The dorsal fin isn't on the pad yet, and I don't want to grab it from Leo, so I'll wait for the back to stand.",
  "say": "Sam, that works for me. I'll take the eye and the dorsal fin, and I'll leave the back and tail to you. Leo, once the back is standing up to the nose, could you pass Sam the pad so the dorsal fin gets drawn? The bottom fin, stroke 3, still needs an owner, so Priya, can you pick that up with the top fin?",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "point": [22, 5],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Team fish: facing left, tail on right, START at top of tail. Leo holds the pad; stroke 1 is the back (tail top to nose), still being laid. Roles now: Grace takes stroke 2 (belly, nose back toward tail). Maya takes tail join and fin edges (not stroke 2). Sam takes the back-adjacent dorsal fin sketch (wants the pad after the back stands). Sofia takes the eye and dorsal fin. Stroke 3 (bottom fin) is unassigned; Priya has the top fin and may take it. Priya watches START. Leave the tail end open so START doesn't loop. Don't build until Leo's back is standing to the nose. Hana asked first for the belly, so give her a turn if Grace stalls. Eye label goes near the nose on the pad."
